title: Blockcassone Plane
description: The atomic canonical unit. A plane is a quad defined by 4 consecutive Hilbert vertices. Its structural properties (position, material, edge patterns) are derived deterministically from the composition seed. Visual rendering properties live in the renderer.

id.description: Unique plane index within the composition.

type.description: 'regular' = within one 8-vertex motif. 'boundary' = spans two adjacent motifs.

axis.description: Which axis this plane is perpendicular to. Determined by the relative positions of its 4 vertices.

vertices.description: The 4 vertex positions defining this plane.

indices.description: Hilbert curve vertex indices [i0, i1, i2, i3]. Consecutive in curve order.

positions.description: Raw integer lattice positions [{x,y,z}, ...]. Renderer normalises to world space as needed.

material.description: Material type. Assigned deterministically via seeded PRNG. A semantic tag — the renderer decides what this looks like.

edgePatterns.description: 3 binary activity patterns — one per curve-traced edge (v0→v1, v1→v2, v2→v3). Each array has length edgeSubdivisions. 1 = active point, 0 = inactive. The 4th (open) edge has no pattern.

from.description: Start vertex index in the Hilbert curve.

to.description: End vertex index in the Hilbert curve.

hierarchy.description: Where this plane sits in the block hierarchy.

motifIndex.description: Which 8-vertex motif (cube) this plane belongs to. = floor(vertexStart / 8).

positionInMotif.description: Which of the 3 planes within its motif (0=first, 1=middle, 2=last).

blockPath.description: Path from root to leaf in the block hierarchy. E.g. [2, 5, 3] = level-2 block #2 → level-1 block #5 → level-0 block #3.

bridgesMotifs.description: Boundary planes only: the two motif indices this plane spans [m-1, m].
